about: SHA-256 of each tool's definition as tools/list returns it (name, title, description, input and output schema, annotations), as JSON with sorted keys. The check job of ci.yml compares a build of every pull request with this file. A hash that differs is a definition that changed, and claude.ai then asks every user who chose "Always allow" to approve that tool again (CLAUDE.md, decision 1b). To change a definition on purpose, group the changes in one release, then rewrite this file from a local build: npm run build, npm run start, node scripts/check-connector.mjs http://localhost:3000/mcp --write-tools-fingerprint scripts/tools-fingerprint.json
